title: FandomCon 2026
tagline: Our biggest day of the year, organised by the FandomVerse team.
description: Two days of everything FandomVerse covers: a cosplay parade, an artist alley, gaming tournaments, K-Pop dance battles, anime and film panels, and the FandomVerse merch booth. The Fan Art Challenge winner is announced live on the main stage.
highlights: Artist alley and fan art wall

title: FandomVerse Fan Art Challenge
tagline: Draw your favourite character and win $1,000.
description: Create original fan art of any character from anime, gaming, movies, TV shows, K-Pop, comics or manga. Digital or traditional, any style. The winner takes home $1,000 and gets featured on the FandomVerse Fan Art page, with the winning piece shown at FandomCon.
highlights: Any character from our seven categories
Digital or traditional, one entry per person
Sign your work so we can credit you
